description: Signalisation verticale - Plaquette is a dataset listed in Swiss national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Kanton Genf. Cette couche représente les plaquettes complémentaires aux signaux de la circulation routière. La plaquette contient des icônes et textes, informations complémentaires nécessaire pour l'interprétation du panneau. La position réelle de la plaquette est donnée par son support (voir couche OTCSVSUPPORT). La plaquette est placé normalement en dessous du panneau dans un but cosmétique. Coverage: Kanton Genf. The portal files it under the publisher Kanton Genf. It offers 9 resource(s) in API, CSV, GML, KML, SHP. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is opendata.swiss terms of use: open use. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-ch-portal.
